Overvalued or undervalued, I learned one thing: the stock and the company are two different entities. Analyzing a company tells you nothing about the stock's movements in the future. I bought at around $16.00, with 100 shares and a covered call. I knew nothing about market cycles, and PLTR was in a stage 1 uptrend (Mark UP Phase) for the next year and a half, until it hit an all-time high. Who cares if the stock is trading at a PE of 200? Is it trading above the 22- and 50-day EMAs on the weekly chart? YES, buy more. The stop-loss is under the 50-day EMA on the weekly chart. Right now, it is fighting in the Distribution Phase. The easy money was made and gone. I Would say More emphasis should be put into day trading as it is less affected by the unpredictable nature of the market...I managed to grow a Portfolio  of around 100k to a decent 932k in the space of a few months.Grateful as always, Adriana Mcgrath, for the regular updates and her beginner’s course that made this possible.
